nameOrigin: type of helmet used by ancient Japanese warriors

pokedexEntries.rb: Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

pokedexEntries.ye: A slim and fast swimmer. It slices its prey with its sharp sickles and drinks the body fluids.

pokedexEntries.go: In the water, it tucks in its limbs to become more compact, then it wiggles its shell to swim fast.

pokedexEntries.si: With sharp claws, this ferocious, ancient POKéMON rips apart prey and sucks their body fluids.

pokedexEntries.cr: It was able to swim quickly through the water by compactly folding up its razor-sharp sickles.

pokedexEntries.rs: KABUTOPS swam underwater to hunt for its prey in ancient times. The POKéMON was apparently evolving from being a water-dweller to living on land as evident from the beginnings of change in its gills and legs.

pokedexEntries.fr: It swims freely through water. It catches prey with its scythe-like arms and drains the victim’s fluids.

pokedexEntries.lg: Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains their fluids.

pokedexEntries.em: KABUTOPS once swam underwater to hunt for prey. It was apparently evolving from being a water dweller to living on land as evident from changes in its gills and legs.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.

pokedexEntries.hg: In the water, it tucks in its limbs to become more compact, then it wiggles its shell to swim fast.

pokedexEntries.ss: With sharp claws, this ferocious, ancient Pokémon rips apart prey and sucks their body fluids.

pokedexEntries.bw: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.

pokedexEntries.x: In the water, it tucks in its limbs to become more compact, then it wiggles its shell to swim fast.

pokedexEntries.y: A slim and fast swimmer. It slices its prey with its sharp sickles and drinks the body fluids.

pokedexEntries.oras: Kabutops swam underwater to hunt for its prey in ancient times. The Pokémon was apparently evolving from being a water dweller to living on land as evident from the beginnings of change in its gills and legs.

pokedexEntries.us: Its body had begun to change so it could function on land. But it didn’t adapt in time and went extinct.

pokedexEntries.um: It swims at speeds of roughly 29 knots, quickly closing in on its prey and slashing into them with its scythes to finish them off.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: A slim and fast swimmer. It sliced its prey with its sharp sickles and drank the body fluids.

pokedexEntries.sw: Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks out the fluids. The discarded body parts become food for other Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.sh: The cause behind the extinction of this species is unknown. Kabutops were aggressive Pokémon that inhabited warm seas.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.
